suggestions.reasoning: As a designer with 2.5 years of experience, you possess the 'human-in-the-loop' intuition necessary to govern AI systems. The evidence indicates that while manual 2D design tasks are highly exposed to automation, the role of an AI Workflow Architect—who bridges the gap between creative intent and automated execution—is in high demand in Vietnam, with salary growth potential significantly higher than traditional design roles.

You already understand how to listen to client briefs; this role simply shifts your focus from manual execution to designing the automated pipelines that produce those assets, leveraging your aesthetic intuition to ensure AI output meets high brand standards.
